title: Directed differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into epidermal keratinocyte-like cells
protocol: Remove the culture medium from hPSCs on day 0.
Wash the cells with 1 mL PBS to remove dead cells.
Treat the cells with ReleSR for 4-5 minutes at 37°C.
Remove ReLeSR and detach the cells with media by gentle pipetting.
Collect the cells in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 130 g for 5 minutes at 22°C.
Plate the cells on Geltrex (1:100) coated plates as small clumps in mTeSR1 containing 10 μM Rock inhibitor.
Split one confluent well of a 6-well plate into two wells (1:2 ratio) to attain a confluency of 90-100% the next day.
Remove the hESC medium.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of DMEM/F12 basal medium.
Add 2.5 mL of unconditioned medium (UCM) supplemented with 1 μM RA and 20 ng/mL BMP4.
Culture the cells for five days in UCM containing 1 μM RA and 20 ng/mL BMP4, changing the media every day.
Treat the cells with ReLeSR for 4–5 min at 37°C on day 5.
Completely remove the dissociating reagent after treatment.
Dissociate the cells with medium and pipette gently to make small clumps of approximately 10–20 cells.
Centrifuge the cells at 130 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Plate the cells at a 1:2 ratio onto Geltrex-coated plates.
Split one well of a 6-well plate into four wells of a 12-well plate and three wells of a 24-well plate for RNA extraction and immunostaining.
Add 10 μM Rock inhibitor during passaging the cells in addition to RA and BMP4.
Mix UCM and N2 medium at a 1:1 ratio and add to the cells on day 6 for stepwise transition.
Change the media completely to N2 medium on day 7.
Continue treating the cells with RA and BMP4 until day 8, changing the media every day.
Withdraw RA and BMP4 from the cells on day 8.
Add 10 ng/mL EGF to the N2 medium.
Culture the cells until day 14 with media change every day to differentiate them into keratinocyte progenitors.
On day 14, wash the keratinocyte progenitor cells with 1 mL PBS.
Treat the keratinocyte progenitor cells with TrypLE for 8–10 min at 37°C.
Gently remove the TrypLE and detach the cells with N2 medium.
Centrifuge the detached cells at 130 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Plate the cells at a 1:2 ratio onto Geltrex-coated plates.
Add 10 μM Rock inhibitor to the fresh media during passaging the cells.
On day 15, withdraw the Rock inhibitor and add N2 medium containing 10 ng/mL EGF.
Continue to grow cells in N2 medium containing 10 ng/mL EGF for 8 days with media change every other day.
On day 23, add 1.2 mM CaCl2 to the N2 medium containing 10 ng/mL EGF for one week to induce keratinocyte maturation and change media every other day.
On day 30, check expression of mature keratinocyte markers using Western blotting and immunostaining.
Treat cells with TrypLE for 4-5 min at 37°C for passaging.
Gently remove TrypLE and detach the cells with N2 medium.
Centrifuge detached cells at 130 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Culture keratinocytes onto Geltrex coated plates in N2 medium containing 10 ng/mL EGF.
Change culture media every other day until day 45.
